description: Raise a deficiency by hand (write — editor) against an in-scope control, an assessed risk, or both. At least one of scf_id or risk_code is required. Starts open.

owner_user_id.description: Owner user — must be a member of the organisation (404 otherwise); see scf_list_members

priority.description: Priority: critical, high, medium, low (platform default medium)

risk_code.description: Risk the deficiency is against — must be one the organisation has assessed (422 otherwise)

scf_id.description: Control the deficiency is against — must be in scope (422 otherwise); obtain from scf_list_scoped_controls

name: scf_create_deficiency
